label.company_type_evidence: Every surface signal says capability centre — "from our Bengaluru engineering center", "partnering across time zones with ... stakeholders based in the US and Europe" — and the JD rebuts it explicitly: "This is not a satellite role. It is that the product anchor for our engineering center." Ownership is stated outright: "Own the product vision, roadmap, and delivery for Gracenote's Data Platform".
label.why_it_matters: The hardest classification in the set, and the reason the GCC dimension needs evidence rather than pattern-matching on "engineering center in India". A classifier keying on surface phrases labels this gcc and is wrong.
